candidate: fixed full I/P initial v1 models; I picture feedback safety constraint
target_rate: rounded actual Annex-B bps from corresponding 300-frame native CQP baseline
evaluation: mean per-picture Y-PSNR and cosine-row Y-WS-PSNR; actual bps; common-range PCHIP BD-rate
timing: elapsed wall seconds under concurrent scheduling; not isolated speed benchmark
decoded_files: independently verified then temporary decoded copies removed; encoded reconstructions retained
job_order: largest target first to reduce long-tail idle time
reconstruction: independent decoder only; temporary files removed after exact size and quality/hash evaluation
reconstruction_identity_gate: 16-frame full SIBRC VVC and both traces exactly match validated encoder-reconstruction run
io_pilot: partial reconstruction-output pilot cancelled and archived; excluded from results
evaluation_pipeline: bounded independent decoder pipeline plus per-frame metric evaluation; at most two temporary reconstructions on fast disk
